verdict.line: You lose if you stand still for Ki Burst range or let her stack Runic Blade charges uncontested; you win every trade where you blind her before she closes.

brief.thesis: Riven has no ranged poke, so every point of damage she deals to you has to come through Valor's engage or Broken Wings' dash chain, both of which are single-target, short-range, and telegraphed. Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) directly answers that by blinding her mid-engage, turning her all-in into a whiffed stun attempt and empowered autos that miss. The data backs this as genuinely even on paper (52.6% over 618 games) but defensive in shape — she wins the all-in if she lands it clean, you win the poke war if she doesn't.

theirWindow.when: Valor and Broken Wings both up
theirWindow.what: She can chain E in to close the gap then Q three times with the knockback on the third hit — if W (Ki Burst) is also up, that stun locks you for the full combo. Back off or pre-emptively Q her face the instant she starts the dash.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap closer and no damage block for 10 (down to 6 at rank 5) seconds. Walk up, poke with E (Toxic Shot) autos, and don't give up trades just because she's in range — she can't punish you back.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 51.8% win rate over 598 games and the 75.3% pick — the extra sustain from two potions matters because Riven's trades are burst, not poke, so you need HP to survive a bad all-in window, not mana.

boots.why: 54.3% win rate over 291 games — Riven has no reliable CC beyond Ki Burst's short stun, so you don't need Swiftness to dodge skillshots; magic pen compounds your poke damage instead.

core.why: Mobility and a proc that rewards you for kiting instead of standing in Ki Burst range

runes.keystoneWhy: 52.4% win rate on this page — the true damage proc rewards landing three autos between her dash windows, which is exactly the poke pattern this lane runs on.

summoners.why: 86.8% pick rate and the highest win rate on record (51.5%) — Ignite punishes her all-in commitment since she has no sustain to out-heal the burn once she's dumped Valor and Broken Wings into you.

playing.title: Q her the instant Valor starts
playing.detail: Blinding Dart has an 8s cooldown and 680 range, far outside her 250-range E — fire it the moment she dashes in so her empowered autos from Runic Blade whiff on arrival.

playing.title: Track Ki Burst cooldown, not just Valor
playing.detail: W (Ki Burst) scales from 11s down to 7s by rank 5 and stuns on hit — if both W and E are up at once, that's her full all-in window and the moment you should be walking back, not forward.

playing.title: Trade freely when E is down
playing.detail: With no gap closer for up to 10 seconds early, she physically cannot punish your E (Toxic Shot) poke — walk up and auto, she has no answer.

playing.title: Respect the Broken Wings knockback on reactivation three
playing.detail: Her Q can be used three times in a short window, each a 275-range dash; the third hit knocks back, which can reposition you into a bad spot or peel you off a kill — don't facecheck brush after she's used two charges.

playing.title: Camouflage after a trade, not before
playing.detail: Standing still long enough to trigger Camouflage near her is only safe once her all-in cooldowns (Q/W/E) are confirmed down — baiting invisibility into a live Ki Burst just feeds her a free stun.

playing.title: Save R (Noxious Trap) for her dash lanes
playing.detail: Cooldown is only 1s per cast, so drop traps on the exact tiles she'll Broken Wings or Valor through — the slow and DoT chip her through an engage even if she lands the stun.

playing.title: Watch for her R before all-in trades late
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's cooldown drops to 10s at rank 5 and grants bonus AD/range plus Wind Slash — if she's near max level and you see her blade glow, assume the all-in is backed by a ranged poke you can't blind away.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner picks, and the 52.6%-over-618-games head-to-head number are measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability interactions, timing windows, and trade patterns explaining why those numbers land this way are this brief's own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful when Riven closes in using Valor (E)! Hit her with Blinding Darts [Q] if she closes in first to block the damage on her basic attacks.
